def test_17_mystery_reason_insufficient_players(self):
        """2 人不足不可开局，补至 3 人后可开始。"""
        host, info = self._host_enter_room()
        room_code = info.get("roomCode")
        self.assertTrue(room_code)

        need_first = max(0, self.insufficient_players - 1)
        if need_first:
            self._seed_guests(room_code, need_first)
            host.sleep(3)
            host.try_call_page_method("_sync")
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.insufficient_players, timeout=25)
        blocked = host.tap_start_expect_blocked()
        if not blocked:
            try:
                host.wait_for_text("至少", timeout=4)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.fail(
                    f"AI迷雾推理局：{self.insufficient_players} 人时开始应被拦截。{exc}"
                )

        add_more = self.min_players - self.insufficient_players
        if add_more > 0:
            self._seed_guests(room_code, add_more)
            host.sleep(3)
            host.try_call_page_method("_sync")
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.min_players, timeout=25)
        self.assertTrue(host.wait_until_start_enabled(timeout=20))
        host.start_game()
        host.wait_phase_text("读本", timeout=120)
        host.assert_no_error_toast_or_modal()
